what_it_does: Uni-Render is a reconfigurable hardware accelerator for multiple types of neural rendering algorithms (NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, hybrid methods). Rather than design separate chips for each algorithm, Uni-Render identifies common operators shared across rendering pipelines (ray marching, Gaussian rasterization, neural network inference, compositing) and builds a configurable dataflow engine that dynamically adapts operator mapping and throughput to match each algorithm's computational profile.
